descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-13 Previous Notes · S24 Real phone camera: photograph a printed synthetic note

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T4 A photographed prior note is read by Google Gemini Flash via Vertex AI. The prototype's photo-reading instruction text is used word for word with only the request format adapted, and the read text ke … (TFA-94425 AC 1; TFA-94425 AC 2; TFA-94425 AC 3; TFA-94425 AC 4)

Test design technique: Device (device) — Look at the layout and gestures at phone size or on a real device (iPhone / Pixel).

Given Debug builds bundled for the local stack on real iOS and Android phones (Android: adb reverse tcp:4510/4511 as in android-lane.ts; iOS: an Xcode debug build whose Convex URL is the Mac's LAN address for 4510/4511), signed in with an e2e-fresh-* account from freshAccount() on the local stack. …

When Previous Notes → Photograph → camera (capture=environment) → shoot the page flat, then tilted with glare

Then The camera opens, and the read text lands in the box for review with every value exactly as printed (or [illegible])

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): The tester compares the read text with the printout value by value; any changed value is a Fail of T4. Two more observations are recorded but not judged here, because they belong to TFA-92591 and are gated: nothing is saved until Save & Extract (U1), and a failed read shows a clear message with nothing lost (U15)

Where it ran: dev; test method DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S24 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-13.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
